name: Svatopluk I of Moravia
role: Ruler of Great Moravia from 870 to 894
contribution: A ruler of Great Moravia, which attained its maximum territorial expansion during his reign.

checks.lead: Svatopluk I or Svätopluk I, also known as Svatopluk the Great, was a ruler of Great Moravia, which attained its maximum territorial expansion during his reign (870–871, 871–894).
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
